messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Word_document output options
parts:
For Word documents, I guess any customization will require non-trivial
effort. I know some people really cannot escape Word, but Pandoc does
not seem to support too much customization of Word documents:

http://johnmacfarlane.net/pandoc/README.html (see --reference-docx)
https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/blob/master/data/reference.docx

The rmarkdown package is just a wrapper of Pandoc, so what
word_document() can do eventually depends on what Pandoc can do. It is
way easier to customize LaTeX/PDF/HTML output, and that is perhaps not
an option for some users.

Regards,
Yihui
